title: High-Accuracy Semi-Analytical Method for Solving the Problem of Electromagnetic Wave Scattering by Arbitrary Ensembles of Parallel Circular Cylinders
summary: A method is proposed for solving the two-dimensional problem of electromagnetic wave scattering by a cluster of an arbitrary number of parallel, infinitely long, homogeneous, non-overlapping right circular cylinders. The cylinders may have arbitrary radii and complex permittivities, and their axes, while remaining parallel, may occupy arbitrary positions in the transverse plane. The solution is constructed using an analytical expansion of the electromagnetic field in cylindrical harmonics.
